title: Nargis's birth chart
metaDescription: Nargis's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 10.3° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, Venus holds a trine to Neptune at 0.1° — close enough to weld taste to imagination. A trine is an open channel. The two cooperate without being asked, which is exactly why it is easy to spend and easy to take for granted.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 10.3° into Gemini — the second decan, which the old scheme hands to Venus. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Gemini (21.9°), Venus in Aries (28.6°), Mars in Leo (10.7°): thought that travels by comparison, attraction declared rather than implied, effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Venus and Neptune: 0.1° from an exact trine. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to. Behind it, Mars trine Uranus at 0.1°, and Venus trine Saturn at 0.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Venus, Saturn, Neptune close a triangle of trines. Three trines close into a circuit the tradition calls a grand trine — ease so complete it can idle unnoticed for years.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks two placements here. Mercury in Gemini at 21.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Aries at 28.6° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives fire 5, air 2, water 2, earth 1, and mutable 4, cardinal 3, fixed 3 across the modes. A fire-weighted chart runs hot at the start line — initiative is its native language. Mercury and Saturn were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.8° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 17.3°.
